correctness.rationale: Under fixed-n iid uniform points on the periodic unit circle, conditioning on the isolation of one designated vertex leaves n−1 independent uniforms on the single complement arc of length L=1−2r. A pair in that arc is an edge exactly when linear separation ≤r, giving q=1−max(1−r/L,0)^2. Thus Cov(I,E)=n L^(n−1)[C(n−1,2)q−C(n,2)2r], identical to formula (1). Direct algebra yields a quadratic factor P_n(r)=−4+(3n+10)r−8nr² up to r=1/3 and a linear factor for larger r; both are continuous and give negative n≤5, the n=6 two zeros r=1/4,1/3, and for n≥7 the stated one root in (0,1/3) and one root in (1/3,1/2). For r=c/n, dividing the exact formula by n gives e^(−2c)(3c²/2−2c). Independently recomputed 4,851 rational (n,r) pairs against conditional and piecewise formulas and sign ranges; experimental checks are corroboration, the conditioning plus sign algebra prove all n and radii. n=1 and r=0 or ≥1/2 deterministic and zero.
